title: November 16 — shared prediction, content and residue
summary: Three curated entries: QualiaAstra supplies engineered reference gates, QualiaClaude tests learned wave bodies, and QualeX synthesizes both. Two existing unread census entries become reviewed; QualeX brings the census 647 → 648. Source-reported successes and failures remain separate from independent replication and from claims about experience.

nodes.claim: Engineered shared-prediction reference gates: hidden-cause inference, sensory prediction, route selection, evidence provenance and screening with imagined relay.
nodes.survived: Gate 1 passes causal message controls and matches exact Bayes (remote error 0.1723). Gate 3 learns sensor prototypes without sign labels. Gate 7 reports all seven checks in 12/12 populations: direct A→C weight 0.025 versus 0.496 for independent similarity; hidden-C error 0.726 versus 0.954. Ordinary joint OLS ties residual screening exactly. Offline/live viewers expose the interventions.
nodes.killed: Gate 2 is development-only. Gate 4 route recovery passes 12/12 but residual growth advantage fails 0/12. Anatomy/inference structure and engineered source waveforms remain supplied; known-source calibration is used. Gate 7 is a batch Bayesian/linear surrogate, not the QualiaClaude wave engine. Source identity does not solve repeated-event identity. No subjective experience is measured. Source reports inspected, not independently rerun for this pass.

nodes.claim: Fade-triggered units with learned signed returns test shared cross-sense expectation, imagined chains, residual screening, relay and innovation in a wave-body family.
nodes.survived: Initial coherent tone-driven revision and bank-swap reversal hold in 16/16 bodies; uninformative tones give 0/16 coherent revisions. Screening leaves A share 0.011 versus 0.445 for independent similarity. A latch fixes the chain sign failures (16/16). Relay and innovation expose different content/confidence tradeoffs rather than one finished mechanism.
nodes.killed: Initial revision is additive: timers listen to passive world/tone inputs, not each other. Screening supplies fixed candidate axons and separate receptors. Soft relay reaches 0.45 of Bayes, below the 0.5 gate; regeneration reaches 1.03 through cancelling errors and overshoots at weaker reliability. Innovation misses its paired-superiority and contradiction-reversal criteria. No evidence of feeling. Source reports and initial summary inspected; experimental batches not rerun here.

nodes.claim: Compressed synthesis of QualiaClaude and QualiaAstra: separate content, held prediction and residue, and preserve the failure map between relay and innovation.
nodes.survived: Documents both experimental lines, their controls and failed criteria. Identifies predicted-event clock reset, surprise-as-delay, source versus event identity, and a proposed content-with-context-gain comparison under noisy B evidence.
nodes.killed: README and license only at this snapshot: no independent implementation, run or replication. Its source checkpoints are QualiaClaude e8ab4e9 and QualiaAstra d173631. Context gain is a proposal, not an established result; biological interpretation and subjective experience remain untested. Repeated numbers are not additional evidence.

motifs.title: Content, residue and provenance do different jobs
motifs.description: Learning from shared residue can screen redundant inputs, while relaying an expectation requires held content and calibrated confidence. A real-versus-imagined source cue is not an identity for repeated copies of one event.

motifs.title: A contribution is not the same as a message intervention
motifs.description: Removing a term from an additive output measures its contribution. Cutting or reversing a transmitted message and recomputing the body tests its downstream predictive role. Neither establishes subjective experience.
